title: CausalDynamics: A large-scale benchmark for structural discovery of dynamical causal models
venue: Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2025) Track on Datasets and Benchmarks
ml_methods: Greedy Relaxations of the Sparsest Permutation (GRaSP)
testbed_rationale: The benchmark provides synthetic dynamical systems, coupled ODEs/SDEs, and reduced-order climate time series specifically targeted at causal structure discovery rather than training or testing physical parameterizations or emulators.
pain_points: Algorithms often infer autocorrelation or dense adjacency where none exists when confronted with nonstationary dynamics
Deep learning-based causal discovery algorithms are often outperformed by non-DL constraint-based and score-based methods in higher-dimensional dynamical systems
Causal discovery evaluation metrics like AUROC can be deceptively optimistic on sparse graphs due to low false-positive rates
Unobserved confounders, time delays, and observational noise obscure conditional independence testing and lead to spurious causal links
extraction_notes: Tier 3 of the benchmark uses reduced-order climate models (XRO conceptual ENSO recharge oscillator and qgs quasi-geostrophic two-layer MAOOAM atmosphere-ocean model).
